title: Claudio brain output
description: What Claude returns on every trigger. claude.js passes this file to `claude -p --json-schema`.

say.description: What the DJ speaks right now. Sent to TTS. Keep it under ~60 seconds of speech. Empty string = stay quiet.

play.description: Songs to queue, in order. Up to 10. Empty array = keep the current queue.

id.description: NetEase song id. Only fill it if it came from a search result. Otherwise leave it out and router.js resolves it with ncm search.

why.description: One short line on why this song. Shown in the Player view.

reason.description: Why this choice overall. Saved to state.db. Never spoken.

segue.description: Short line to speak between songs or when the queue ends. Empty string = none.
